summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing daily purchases under its buy-back announced 28 October 2026, executed through Goldman Sachs International. On 5 November 2026 it bought 170,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$13.1762 (range US$12.8640–13.3800) and 46,800 shares in Hong Kong at HK$139.6436 average. Cumulative repurchases total 4,049,461 shares for about US$69.8m; issued capital stands at 17,134,040,846 shares, with no shares held in treasury. Watch pace of execution and HK cancellation timing.
